New Motivation:
Higher total daily energy intake (TDEI) can lead to an increase in group-level BMI because, on average, excess caloric intake may result in fat accumulation. However, this relationship is influenced by various factors such as differences in individual metabolism, physical activity levels, and genetic factors, so not all individuals or groups with higher TDEI will necessarily have proportionally higher BMIs.
